honor: Olympic Order in gold (Collare dell'Ordine Olimpico d'Oro)
detail: The IOC's highest distinction, conferred in May 2026 'in recognition of the commitment and support' provided by the Italian government, according to ANSA; it followed the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic Games hosted by Italy in February 2026.
